page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.e3.medium is an x86_64 server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 2 physical cores and 2 vCPUs, providing a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPU resources, relying entirely on network-attached storage for its disk operations.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.e3.medium operates in the lower performance tiers. In CPU-intensive tasks, the instance achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1102.08 and a multi-core score of 2162.17, both placing in the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. Cryptographic and compression tests show similar constraints, with a Passmark CPU encryption score of 812.86 and single-threaded gzip compression throughput of 18.89 GB/sec. Memory performance is also modest, with uncached large-block read bandwidth measured at 17.2 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 14.52 GB/sec.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, the instance offers a memory-optimized profile suitable for workloads requiring more RAM than compute power. However, its low processing throughput, as evidenced by a Passmark database operations score of 554.18 and a static web serving throughput of 2.49 GB/sec, makes it less suitable for high-traffic web hosting or intensive database transactions. The ecs.e3.medium is best positioned for lightweight memory-bound applications, small-scale caching, or development environments where compute demands are minimal but a 16.0 GB memory footprint is required.
